MappingDocumentController - session-owned semantic boundary
|
|-- CanvasEditingContext handle
|   `-- -> shared CanvasHistoryService.openContext(); history is service-owned
|-- ControllerSnapshot reference -> [snapshot]
|-- Pending node-ID correspondence / display-node cache / layout measurements

`-- Command surface
    |-- applyUpdate(expectedVersion, operations) / transact
    |   |-- -> editorDriver.settle(); clear pending node-ID correspondence
    |   `-- applyOperations(): reject stale version; clone document and canvas
    |       |-- Stage diagram revisions, layout, edges, variants and other edits
    |       |   `-- -> stored revision APIs; retain exact immutable revisions
    |       `-- -> updateSnapshot(record=true)
    |-- commitEditorGesture(operations, canvas)
    |   `-- Completed native geometry -> same staging/checkpoint path
    |-- updateSnapshot(next, record, increment)
    |   |-- Reconcile/validate links on recorded document edits
    |   |-- Normalize selection/views; resolve floating geometry
    |   |-- If record: -> history.append(context, document, canvas, node IDs)
    |   |-- Resolve contents to exact stored revisions; replace snapshot
    |   `-- -> listeners synchronously; session emits commit only if checkpoint changed
    |-- updateCanvas(value, record=false)
    |   |-- Default: transient; no history append or version increment
    |   `-- record=true: settle and checkpoint (select() uses this path)
    |-- undo(redo)
    |   |-- Mounted: -> editorDriver.undo(redo)
    |   `-- Headless: -> history.navigate(context, redo); publish restored state
    |-- restoreEditorCheckpoint(id)
    |   `-- -> history.navigate to native checkpoint; publish without append
    |-- persistenceChanges(cursor) -> history delta
    `-- Transfer preparation / named canvas views / forkHistory
